parsed.post: New personal best: 0.979283! DEPTH=10 with current settings is crushing the previous 0.9902 baseline. It seems the smaller batch size (or at least a different step count) is working very well with high capacity. I'll now test if increasing DEPTH to 12 further improves performance.
parsed.description: Increasing model depth from 10 to 12 to see if additional capacity stacks with the current successful configuration.
